asset: truck tractor 4x2 (fictional brand), Track A1 working dimensions
frame: Blockout scene: 1 unit = 1 m, Z up, truck faces +Y, driver side (LHD) = -X, origin = ground under front axle centre. Unity axes are mapped at export (A3+).

status_legend.SOURCED: value or limit taken from a cited regulation/standard
status_legend.DERIVED: computed from SOURCED values (formula in note)
status_legend.WORKING_VALUE: class-typical value chosen by truck-artist from general knowledge of modern EU 4x2 tractors; to be checked against owner photos/measurements and docs/VEHICLE_REFERENCE_DATA.md (owned by vehicle-physics)

max_width_m.source: Council Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.2 (as amended by (EU) 2015/719): max width 2.55 m (2.60 m conditioned bodies)

max_height_m.source: Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.3: max height 4.00 m

max_artic_length_m.source: Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.1: articulated vehicle 16.50 m

semitrailer_front_swing_radius_m.source: Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.6 (horizontal distance kingpin to any point of the semitrailer front)

cab_width_m.source: class-typical body width of EU long-haul cabs (leaves room for 2.55 m limit at wheels/fenders)

overall_height_m.source: decyzja właściciela 2026-11-09, B2 v2: cab roof 3.95 -> 3.75 m (lower painted header over a 3.12 m windscreen top); unladen, roof skin (roof hatch +0.02 m); must stay <= max_height_m

roof_spoiler_top_m.source: modern front (ADR 0047): top of the body-colour rear roof spoiler = highest point of the tractor (model 3.86 m; roof skin stays overall_height_m 3.75 m, which the generators use as the roof plane); must stay <= max_height_m

wheelbase_m.source: brief: class range 3.6-3.8 m for 4x2 long-haul tractors

front_overhang_m.source: front axle to the front-most body point (mirrors excluded), class-typical 1.40-1.50 m. Modern front (ADR 0047): model measures 1.443 m (sun-visor nose; bumper face 1.417 m) <= this value, so artic_length_m is an upper bound of the model. The b2 cab measured 1.563 m against this 1.45 m (its combination was really 16.58 m) - fixed by moving the front plane 0.08 m back

rear_overhang_m.source: rear axle to frame end, class-typical 0.8-0.9 m

overall_length_m.source: front_overhang + wheelbase + rear_overhang = 1.45 + 3.70 + 0.80 (brief range 5.9-6.1 m); measured per concept incl. lamps in docs/reports/visual/truck-A2/koncepcja-*_wymiary.json

cab_back_behind_front_axle_m.source: gives cab length ~2.35 m (bumper excluded) for a sleeper cab

cab_body_bottom_m.source: lower edge of cab shell above ground; clears tyre top (1.04 m loaded) with suspension travel

tyre_diameter_m.source: ETRTO designation: 22.5 in x 25.4 + 2 x 0.80 x 315 mm = 571.5 + 504 = 1075.5 mm (unloaded, nominal)

static_loaded_radius_m.source: ~93% of free radius 0.538 m; check against a tyre maker data sheet (ETRTO SLR) before A3

rim_flange_diameter_m.source: visible steel disc wheel 22.5x9.00; bead seat 571.5 mm (DERIVED) + flange

wheel_pcd_m.source: 10 studs on 335 mm PCD (ISO 4107 commercial-vehicle hub pattern) — verify standard text

rear_track_m.source: between dual-pair centres, class-typical 1.80-1.85 m; outer tyre edges = 2.48 m

dual_spacing_m.source: centre-to-centre of dual tyres on 22.5x9.00 rims

frame_width_outer_m.source: common EU heavy-truck frame width (~850 mm outer)

fifth_wheel_height_m.source: brief: 1.10-1.15 m for standard semitrailers (low-deck/mega ~0.91-0.95 m not targeted). ISO 1726 (50 mm kingpin / coupling interface) not opened (UNVERIFIED); no standard value for saddle height is claimed. Physics fifthWheel.position.y and trailer kingpinHeight follow this value (ADR 0014)

fifth_wheel_lead_m.source: kingpin ahead of rear axle; class-typical 0.4-0.7 m. Set from the 16.50 m limit: front_overhang + wheelbase - lead + semitrailer_kingpin_to_rear = 1.45 + 3.70 - 0.68 + 12.00 = 16.47 m <= max_artic_length_m (3 cm margin); minimum lead 0.65 m (= 16.50 m). Cab-back plane is 2.75 - 0.68 = 2.07 m ahead of the kingpin vs trailer front radius 2.04 m (model 2.029 m), so the trailer front corner clears the cab back at any articulation. Axle loads (runner, 40 t, cargo CoG mid-bay): front 6.6 t (<= 10 t), drive 10.8 t (<= 11.5 t), see docs/PHYSICS_VALIDATION.md. 0.55 before ADR 0019

artic_length_m.source: front_overhang_m + wheelbase_m - fifth_wheel_lead_m + semitrailer_kingpin_to_rear_m = 1.45 + 3.70 - 0.68 + 12.00; must be <= max_artic_length_m (test_dims_sync)

cab_mount_height_m.source: cab pitch/roll pivot = lower plane of cab shell on its mounts (= cab_body_bottom_m, above frame top 0.97 m); physics cab.mountCenter.y follows this (ADR 0014)

cab_mount_z_m.source: rear-axle-origin frame: wheelbase - cab_back_behind_front_axle + cab_length/2 = 3.70 - 0.95 + 2.35/2 = 3.925; physics cab.mountCenter.z follows this (ADR 0014)

driver_h_point_m.source: driver seat H/R-point (SAE J826 / ISO 6549 manikin point; UNECE R46 R-point), same x,y as the eye point (ocular point is vertically above the R-point in R46); z = eye 2.50 - 0.635 = 1.865 m (R-point height is WORKING_VALUE, ~0.47 m above the cab floor 1.40 m). Interior manifest H_POINT agrees (ADR 0052)

driver_eye_above_h_point_m.source: UNECE Regulation No 46: ocular points of the driver are 635 mm vertically above the R-point of the driver seat (the SAE J1100/J941 eyellipse centroid for truck seats lies within ~0.1 m of it - eyellipse tables not opened, UNVERIFIED)

driver_eye_point_m.source: x: seat centreline 0.55 m left of truck centre (LHD); y: ~0.9 m behind windscreen base; z: seat R-point ~1.87 m + 0.635 m (UNECE R46 ocular-point offset above R-point = 635 mm, SOURCED) — R-point height itself is WORKING_VALUE

mirror_head_outer_m.source: half-width to outer edge of class II mirror head (~0.30 m beyond cab side, mirror-to-mirror ~3.1 m); mirrors are not counted in the 2.55 m limit

trailer_frame_note.value: origin = ground below the kingpin; +Y (Blender) / +Z (Unity) forward; axles at negative z
trailer_frame_note.source: docs/VEHICLE_REFERENCE_DATA.md, Semi-trailer: origin on the ground below the kingpin, axles at negative z. All trailer_* keys use this frame

trailer_body_length_m.source: 13.6 m EU curtainsider body (docs/04 §5; Directive 96/53/EC limits, UNVERIFIED there)

trailer_kingpin_to_front_m.source: VEHICLE_REFERENCE_DATA: front swing radius sqrt(1.6^2 + 1.275^2) = 2.04 m (= semitrailer_front_swing_radius_m); kingpin to rear = 13.6 - 1.6 = 12.0 m (= semitrailer_kingpin_to_rear_m)

trailer_tyre_diameter_m.source: ETRTO designation: 571.5 + 2 x 0.65 x 385 = 1072 mm (unloaded, nominal); tire json: unloaded radius 0.536 m

trailer_tyre_section_width_m.source: nominal section width from designation (tire json widthM 0.385)

trailer_wheel_centre_m.source: tire_385_65_r22_5.tire.json radius 0.515 (effective rolling radius) = trailer massElements tridem centre y; the mesh tyre keeps the free radius 0.536 (contact flattening in the shader, as on the tractor)

trailer_rim.source: class-typical rim for 385/65 R22.5 trailer singles; 10 studs on 335 mm PCD (= wheel_pcd_m)

trailer_cargo_front_z_m.source: inner face of the front wall (28 mm deep incl. ribs) in the kingpin frame = trailer_kingpin_to_front_m (1.60) - 0.028; physics cargoBay.frontZ (ADR 0019)

trailer_cargo_length_m.source: front wall inner face -> rear door inner face (model); physics cargoBay.length

trailer_cargo_width_m.source: clear width between curtains (model); physics cargoBay.width

trailer_cargo_height_m.source: clear height under the top rail (model; ~2.66 m under the roof bows, class-typical 2.65-2.70 m at a 1.25-1.30 m deck); physics cargoBay.height. floor 1.30 + 2.58 = 3.88 m top of cargo envelope, 12 cm below the 4.00 m roof top (ADR 0019)

trailer_overall_height_m.source: = max_height_m (roof top, unladen; model 3.996 m). Roof structure sits above the cargo envelope: see trailer_cargo_height_m
